topic: Why Are you wasting time on social media?

lines.text: Every scroll steals minutes you could be building a stronger jawline and better posture.
lines.search_term: young man scrolling phone on couch close up dim lighting

lines.text: Studies show the average guy loses three hours a day to endless feeds, a loss you can convert into six extra reps at the gym.
lines.search_term: clock face overlay with phone screen gym equipment background

lines.text: Those algorithmic dopamine hits are a shortcut to low confidence, because real confidence comes from physical progress, not likes.
lines.search_term: confident muscular man looking away from phone outdoor sunrise

lines.text: When you compare yourself to filtered strangers, your own mirror image starts to fade.
lines.search_term: man looking at mirror phone reflection showing edited photos

lines.text: Cut the scroll and you'll notice your posture straightens, your eye contact sharpens, and women notice the change instantly.
lines.search_term: handsome man standing tall direct eye contact city street

lines.text: A simple 30-minute daily boundary can add up to 180 hours a year-enough time for a six-pack to emerge.
lines.search_term: timer counting down overlay of abdominal muscles transformation

lines.text: Imagine an AI that scans your daily habits and gives you a 0-100 attractiveness score, highlighting exactly where you're losing points.
lines.search_term: futuristic AI interface displaying attractiveness meter male silhouette

lines.text: The tool will flag the minutes you waste on scrolling and reward the minutes you spend lifting, grooming, and learning.
lines.search_term: split screen of phone scrolling vs man working out data overlay

lines.text: Turn those wasted hours into real assets: stronger shoulders, deeper voice, and a magnetic presence.
lines.search_term: muscular shoulders close up of throat confident smile

lines.text: Stop letting the feed dictate your value-take control, measure your progress, and watch attraction levels skyrocket.
lines.search_term: man looking at progress chart on laptop confident posture bright lighting
